summary: Frontend-only iter25 verification of the 404 -> clean-diagnostic branches on Admin SMS (dry-run + test-send) and Login (email). All backend endpoints were mocked via page.route on **/api/**. 20 of 21 assertions PASSED against the preview URL. The single failing assertion ('no 123456 on /admin/settings/sms DOM') is a false positive caused by the DLT entity-ID placeholder pattern '1101234567890123456' (a PEID format hint on admin-setting-dlt-entity-id) — it is NOT an OTP leak.
critical_code_review_comments: iter25 fix is correctly scoped: catch blocks branch on `status === 404` before the raw-error fallback in both sendTestSms and dryRunSms (AdminSettings.jsx L130-146 & L170-187) and in Login.jsx handleEmailLogin (L173+). Clean.

The 'no 123456 on DOM' regression rule collides with the legit DLT PEID placeholder '1101234567890123456'. If this rule matters for future audits, tighten it to check for exactly ' 123456' or the specific demo OTP string, not any substring.
test_credentials: Not required — page.route mocked /api/users/me as admin and injected localStorage slotnow_token/slotnow_user before navigating to /admin/settings/sms.
seed_data_creation: None. All backend traffic mocked via page.route.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter25 confirmed. Assertions covered: Dry-run 404 clean toast+panel+phone_that_would_be_sent, Test-send 404 clean toast+panel, Dry-run 500 raw label 'Dry-run FAILED (raw error from backend) — HTTP 500', 502 label, network label 'HTTP N/A (network)', 200 success panel (slate not rose), Email login 404 toast 'Email login is not enabled on this backend build — please use phone + OTP'. iter24 phone normalization regression still holds (dry-run POST body observed as {"phone":"919876543210"} for 10-digit input). iter23 DLT alphanumeric preservation regression not re-tested this iteration but no code changes touched those fields.
rca of the issue: User's reported bug ('Dry-run FAILED (raw error from backend) — HTTP 404 Clear {"detail":"Not Found"}') is fully mitigated on the frontend. Backend rollback removed 3 endpoints; frontend now intercepts the 404 and shows a clean explanation that (a) tells the user WHY (endpoint no longer deployed), (b) tells them what to do (use OTP flow / ask backend team), and (c) still surfaces the normalized phone (919876543210) so iter24's phone-normalization fix stays visible even without a backend response.
